codeReview.summary: Reviewed the fix feature metadata, transcript skeleton, handoff, the original failed review, the completed original feature diff (`e0f843c271ebbd255ba47b624c01f1cff2ddc84f`), and the fix diff (`8d5503905c398a8fce6485c599e116c6bca9ba22`). The prior blocking populated-audit gap is now closed: `apps/web/tests/account-shell.test.tsx` and `apps/web/tests/linear-management.test.ts` both render the routed populated Linear audit fixture and assert description-list semantics for the delivery and closeout cards. The remaining problem is the new cold-bootstrap regression coverage: the fix adds the crucial page-level Suspense boundary in `apps/web/app/account/page.tsx`, but the added `apps/web/tests/account-shell-hydration.test.tsx` suite never renders that route or otherwise proves the boundary participates in the first authenticated bootstrap render. It only checks the route cache exports, the standalone loading shell, and isolated `ControlPlaneShell` hydration. That leaves the route-level first-render agreement dependent on the manual browser run rather than on an automated guard that would fail if the page-level bootstrap fix regressed.

issues.description: The new regression suite does not actually exercise the cold bootstrap fix in `apps/web/app/account/page.tsx:15-20`. At `apps/web/tests/account-shell-hydration.test.tsx:175-216` it only asserts `dynamic`/`fetchCache`, renders `AccountShellLoading` by itself, and hydrates `ControlPlaneShell` with identical server/client props. Reverting the page-level `<Suspense fallback={<AccountShellLoading />}>` would still leave this file green, so the automated coverage does not strongly prove that the first authenticated `/account` server render and first client render still agree on the real cold bootstrap path.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The shared web-control-plane skill still does not explicitly tell workers to inspect the first bridge-cookie load before any reload, even though the original account-shell handoff identified that a warmed reload can mask the failure. This fix wrote a dedicated library note for the nuance instead of the base skill carrying it.
